北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云炎热 31℃，注意防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and hot 31℃, remember sunscreen & hydration!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波中雨 32℃，体感 34℃。雨天闷热，出门记得带伞。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has moderate rain 32℃, feels 34℃. Humid and stuffy, remember your umbrella.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨 27℃，湿度大。出门带伞，体感稍闷热。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain 27℃, high humidity. Carry an umbrella, feels a bit stuffy.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨 26℃，风力 4 级。带伞防风，湿度大。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain 26℃, wind level 4. Bring an umbrella, it's humid.
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳小雨 26℃，体感 29℃。湿度高，带伞防闷热。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has light rain 26℃, feels 29℃. High humidity, bring an umbrella to avoid stuffiness.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雨 31℃，风力 5 级。雨大风强，注意安全带伞！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has heavy rain 31℃, wind level 5. Strong rain & wind, stay safe & bring an umbrella!
杭州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 5级

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京中雨 24℃，湿度 100%。雨天路滑，带伞别着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has moderate rain 24℃, 100% humidity. Slippery roads, bring an umbrella & don't catch a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云 35℃，体感 40℃。请注意防暑降温，多喝水！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy 35℃, feels 40℃. Stay cool, prevent heatstroke, and drink plenty of water!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云 30℃，注意防晒哦。保持好心情！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy 30℃, remember sunscreen. Keep in a good mood!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云 31℃，体感 36℃。炎热，注意防晒防暑！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy 31℃, feels 36℃. Hot, remember sunscreen & prevent heatstroke!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云 35℃，炎热。请注意防暑降温，多喝水！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy 35℃, hot. Stay cool, prevent heatstroke, and drink plenty of water!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴天 27℃，体感适宜，外出注意防晒。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny 27℃, feels pleasant. Mind the sun when going out.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云 29℃，体感适宜。愿你有个愉快的一天！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy 29℃, feels comfortable. Wish you a pleasant day!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云 26℃，体感舒适。享受这宜人的天气吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy 26℃, feels comfortable. Enjoy the pleasant weather!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴 27℃，湿度大风力 4 级。出行注意阵风。

青岛.name: 青岛

大连.name: 大连

漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is cloudy 28℃, feels 31℃. High humidity, watch out for stuffiness!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪中雨 32℃，体感闷热，出行带伞防湿滑。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has moderate rain 32℃, feels stuffy. Take an umbrella & watch out for slippery roads.
